purpose: Aggressive 10 USDT Binance USD-M candidate; new rule has no profitability evidence.
hypothesis: A daily BTC regime gate can remove a material share of long-only breakout losses in bearish or non-trending conditions.
A 4h breakout has thicker expected move than the consumed 1h/20h candidate and can tolerate fixed fees and stop-gap reserve better.
LG pressure-budget sizing can cap adverse stop-gap loss while preserving aggressive upside when the exchange minimum is executable.

selection.eligible_before_priority: completed signal, costs, filters, liquidity and all sizing caps must pass

clocks.regime_bar: latest complete daily BTCUSDT bar actually available at decision
clocks.decision: after completed signal close; earliest fill strictly later than decision
clocks.missing_or_incomplete_bar: block new entries, preserve native stop and reconcile; missing input is not a fresh zero target

regime_gate.risk_on: latest completed BTC daily close > SMA200 including that completed close
regime_gate.risk_off: daily predicate false: cancel pending entry and reduce-only flatten; then cash
regime_gate.unknown: block new risk and retain native stop while reconciling

signal.atr_method: Wilder; require 100 continuous completed 4h bars to initialize
signal.long_trigger: C[t] > max(H[t-20:t-1]); current bar excluded from threshold
signal.initial_stop: conservative entry reference - 1.5 * ATR[t]; freeze before submission; never narrow to meet order minimum
signal.entry_price_limit: actual executable price <= signal close + 0.30 ATR; otherwise skip
signal.trailing: completed close >= entry + 2*frozen initial stop distance activates max(previous_stop, highest post-entry completed close - 2*current ATR); effective after close; never loosen
signal.stop_crossed_on_update: reduce-only flatten; do not submit an invalid immediate-trigger replacement

cost_model.live_fee: actual user/symbol commission; unknown blocks live
cost_model.adverse_funding_reserve: maximum absolute settled regular rate available in prior 72h * ceil(remaining hold hours / point-in-time interval); conservatively compare known next-rate estimate
cost_model.funding_interval: observed fundingInfo and nextFundingTime; historical fallback to last two prior regular settlements with assumption disclosure; never backfill current interval
cost_model.live_spread_slippage: estimate from fresh executable depth; count fees and spread/slippage once
cost_model.funding_overrun_exit: at completed signal bar exit if sunk adverse funding + remaining reserve + ordinary round-trip friction >20% frozen initial stop distance
cost_model.funding_credit: record signed actual funding; reserve treats no future credit as income

sizing.stop_rounding: long stop round UP to PRICE_FILTER tick before sizing; require 0 < stop < executable price
sizing.quantity: floor to exact decimal common grid satisfying all applicable LOT_SIZE and MARKET_LOT_SIZE filters; not min(stepSize)

exchange_leverage.reduction: reduce to 4/3/2/1 if audited bracket-based liquidation distance <3*(structural stop distance + gap); recompute margin cap

sizing.margin_cap: N/leverage <=0.40*E; fees/funding reserve and actual free USDT also fit
sizing.min_order_failure: skip; never inflate quantity beyond risk budget

controls.next_risk_budget: min(active_risk_fraction*E,remaining concurrent stress risk,remaining 6% rolling-24h loss headroom,remaining 20% unit-NAV drawdown headroom in USDT); reserve pending intents before submission
controls.loss_limit_action: cancel entry intents; reduce-only flatten; reconcile then HALT

engineering_before_live: causal replay and minute-stop plus fault verification
verify current algo-stop capability and duplicate/timeout recovery in appropriate test environment
genuine public forward record; private dry-run only with later read-only credential authorization
funded preflight and exact executable canary scope
promotion.first_live: one explicitly owner-authorized protected round trip, <=0.30 USDT modeled stress risk at 10 USDT
promotion.regular_live: separate explicit recurring-live scope after reconciled canary; engineering success does not establish edge
promotion.profit_evidence_review: at least 30 independent closed opportunities plus sufficient regime coverage; elapsed time alone never grants trading or expansion
promotion.kill: 20% unit-NAV drawdown or 6% rolling daily loss -> flatten/HALT; protection/unknown failures -> reconcile/flatten/HALT; nonpositive frozen candidate net results -> research review without automatic tuning
promotion.executor_host: dedicated authorized 24/7 host undecided; no existing VPS/WSL service or credential migration authorized

accounting.equity_definition: dedicated authorized USDT trading equity net of estimated exit costs; quarantined new deposits excluded
accounting.pnl: trading realized/unrealized PnL + signed funding - fees; transfers separate
accounting.unitized_nav: initial units=E_initial, NAV=1; deposit D issues D/NAV_pre units, withdrawal W redeems W/NAV_pre units; transfers never change NAV or its high-water mark
accounting.cashflow_example: 10->9 trading equity is NAV 0.9; deposit 10 issues 11.111111 units, equity 19, NAV remains 0.9 and drawdown remains 10%
accounting.new_capital_scope: while flat reconcile new funds and bind approved new live scope; preserve NAV, downshift and HALT; profits may compound within the sleeve
accounting.journal: decision/intent, fill/fee/funding, protective ACK and reconciliation

evidence_boundary.permitted_claim: candidate mechanism and execution design only

execution_design.entry: one marketable LIMIT IOC within quote and signal caps; partial fill cancels remainder; protect actual quantity
execution_design.native_stop: current USD-M conditional algo STOP_MARKET SELL, CONTRACT_PRICE, closePosition=true; omit quantity/reduceOnly when schema requires
execution_design.ordinary_exit: reduce-only MARKET for reconciled full position
execution_design.conditional_order_api: POST /fapi/v1/algoOrder; reconcile algo and ordinary order IDs separately
execution_design.price_protect: avoid configuration delaying emergency trigger on mark/contract divergence
execution_design.stop_failure: resolve possible accepted order by intent ID, cancel/confirm as needed, reduce-only flatten verified exposure then HALT
execution_design.stop_replacement: retain old stop until replacement acknowledgement where venue supports coexistence; rejected replacement retains old stop; crossed proposed stop flattens
execution_design.unknown_order: deterministic ID query plus fill/position/order reconciliation; never blind resend
execution_design.unexpected_account_changes: block new risk and reconcile; do not alter unrelated holdings

research_plan.comparison_common: same 3% pressure sizing, 5x/2x/40% caps, costs/funding/filters, 72h hold and 8h cooldown; ATR/breakout/trailing horizons change with interval and are disclosed
cost_cases: fixed base fills and quantities under double costs
1% stop-gap included in sizing and fills
controls: BTC/ETH/SOL unlevered fixed basket only when actually executable, otherwise infeasible
research_plan.history_role: 2025 and 2026 development windows already consumed; all new-rule reruns are diagnostics, not independent validation; no 2025 rule selection
research_plan.independent_evidence: real startup after configuration freeze; do not backdate
metrics: mean net structural R and stress R separately
research_plan.success: gate reduces bearish loss/drawdown while preserving meaningful bullish net return; net positive mean R and account PnL required for profit claim; no fills is not robustness
